reviews.comment: Most lecture slides have way too much going on for simple concepts, sometimes even missing formulas. Homework and projects were significantly harder than the material taught in class. Quiz prep materials would only be provided the night before the quizzes themselves. Grades took forever causing stress, even past Q-drop deadline. Pray on curves
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I honestly don't understand the hate that Dr. Kaunas receives because he is actually pretty decent. All his assignments are super easy and he curves every quiz.  My only complaint is that he takes a while to grade things, but if you go to class and do all your work this is an easy A.

Never take Dr. Kaunas. He does not know what he is teaching at all. It's insane. I went to Dr. Horn for help on Dr. Kaunas' quiz because he is unhelpful and judgmental. Please just take Dr. Horn. I can't explain the torture I went through for this class. Classes end tomorrow and Homework 2 still isn't graded BTW. Slow grader and gives no feedback!!

The professor is understanding-ish but cannot teach and is wildly disorganized. There have been many times when he has taught something wrong and has to redo it, students correct him. He also posts assignments later than he said he would, and rarely will extend it when it is his fault. Projects and homework take hours, and grading takes months.

Worst prof I have ever had. Genuinely horrible. Shows up to class late, wildly unprepared, and unhelpful in explaining everything. He constantly has the wrong formulas and slides for class so there's about 100 announcements where he has to fix what he said/went over in class. I would not recommend this class to anyone. You have been warned.

Don't do it. Worst professor ever to teach a class. He doesn't know whats going on in his slides and when you correct him in class he becomes passive aggressive. The workload for this class is insane compared to the other professor. The class is supposed to teach stats software but he makes every thing due by hand.

There is not a word in the English dictionary that can describe just how little statistics Dr. Kaunas actually knows. The number of times that he would repeatedly mess up examples (that he pulls from the book) or speed through a piss-poor excel demonstration was almost certainly statistically significant. Don't take this class with Dr. Kaunas.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took his BMEN 250 class. It was made clear that the curriculum was supposed to involve us using statistics software to learn, however we were required to do everything by hand, which was difficult as he doesn't know how to do stats. This review may be useless, as I am sure they will not allow him to teach this class again.

If I could give this dude a negative score I would because a rating of 1 is generous. No one has a clue what he's doing and listening to him teach only makes you more confused. Start the projects early if you have to take him because he claimed the projects take only 30 minutes, but they take about 2-3 hours because of how badly he teaches. >:(

He has no clue about the material he is teaching and often has equations and work done very wrong. He doesn't like answering student questions or will say he doesn't have time for you. He shows up to class late often which wastes time. Absolutely avoid this professor he has no clue how to teach.

This professor does not know the material that he is teaching. He often goes through problems, answering his own questions incorrectly and being corrected by his students. He assigns so much homework along with extremely difficult projects. I am spending more time in this class than all of my other classes combined.

This professor has never taught a statistic class before and has no idea what he is doing. He constantly says the wrong things and teaches the wrong information. He copies the textbook we are given for his lectures and it is hard to understand. The homework is unnecessarily hard and long. Do not take BMEN250 with this professor if you can help it!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

She is a saint. PLEASE DONT TAKE KAUNAS!
